read.thesis: Novo raised 2026 guidance to -2% to +2% CER sales and operating profit with Q3 sales +4%, but US sales only +1% and Q4 implied growth looks weak on gross-to-net and LOE; no supply-side capacity data disclosed.

triggers.label: Wegovy US price erosion 30-35%
triggers.quote: we've again seen 30%, 35% in the quarter, again, with the variability

triggers.label: Ozempic price erosion 10-15% annually
triggers.quote: suggested the 10%-15% price erosion on an annual basis is the way to think about it
triggers.highlight: 10%-15% price erosion on an annual basis

triggers.label: Wegovy pill volume +20% QoQ
triggers.quote: In Q3, Wegovy pill volumes grew around 20% versus Q2

triggers.label: Sales guide raised, midpoint 0%
triggers.quote: we now expect adjusted sales growth of -2% to +2% and adjusted operating profit growth of -2% to +2%, both at CER

triggers.label: China LOE and Canada price cuts
triggers.quote: performance in Canada was negatively impacted by lower realized prices following the loss of exclusivity for semaglutide
triggers.highlight: lower realized prices following the loss of exclusivity

guidance.quote: we now expect adjusted sales growth of -2% to +2% and adjusted operating profit growth of -2% to +2%, both at CER
Adjusted operating profit growth is now expected to be from - 2% to + 2% at constant exchange rates
the improved free cash flow outlook, now expected between DKK 60 billion and DKK 70 billion

red_flags.label: Q4 implied growth weak; gross-to-net tough comp
